---
title: "Inline code"
engine: pari-gp
format: html
---

```{gp}
#| include: false
p = nextprime(10^20);
```

The prime is `{gp} p`, which has `{gp} #Str(p)` digits.

Inline code sees the state at its own position: `{gp} 6*7`.

A fenced block must not be evaluated:

```markdown
The prime is `{gp} p`.
```

After the block, substitution still works: `{gp} 2^10`.

A code span that shows a fence, ` ```{gp} `, is not an expression, and
neither is ``` `{gp}` ``` on its own.
